subject: maths
question: If ΔPQR ≅ ΔSTR, ∠Q = 50° and ∠P = 70° and PQ is 8 cm. Which of the following options is NOT correct?
solution:
**Given:**

∠Q = 50°

∠P = 70°

ΔPQR similar to ΔSTR

**Concept used:**

If two triangles are similar then the ratio of their sides and their corresponding angle will be equal.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a56fae8eadfe15574e49762055f99583b382053fc34c964cb414d9e9cdc9410.png] 

⇒ ∠R = 180 - (∠P + ∠Q) = 180 - 120 = 60° 

According to the concept,

∠S = 70° [∵ ∠P = 70° ]

Similarly, ∠T = 50° [∵ ∠Q = 50° ]

Also,

PQ = ST, QR = TR, PR = SR, and ∠PRQ = 60°

But, ∠TSR = 70° 

So ∠TSR = 80° will be not correct. 

**∴ The option 1 is NOT correct.**

3e
